test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

ENORMOUS
solution:
The correct answer is- 'massive' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's understand the meaning of the given word:
 
• The word enormous is an adjective and it means *extremely large*. (अत्यंत विशाल।) 
 
 
• Example: *The wealthy will get **enormous **tax cuts under the proposal.*
 
 
 
• By this meaning, we can say that 'massive' is a similar word to 'enormous.'

Thus *option 4 *is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The antonyms of the given word are:

 
 
• minute, small, tiny
 
 
 
• The meaning of the given options is:
 
 
• massive - very large in size, amount, or number (आकार, राशि या संख्या में बहुत बड़ा)
 
• common - found in large numbers or in a large quantity (बड़ी संख्या में या अधिक मात्रा में पाया जाना)
 
• tiny - very small (बहुत छोटा)
 
• ordinary - not exceptional in any way especially in quality, ability, size or degree (गुणवत्ता, क्षमता या आकार में साधारण)
